book.name: 1 Tesalonaika
book.title: TESALONAIKA TANGE DUPANYA POLOME PEPA PYAO PYASAKAMAIYAMO WAMBAO DOKO

content: Kamongonya Gii Dokonya Leamo Doko
Kaimii paluma, Kamongo ipata ee kanapi, yuu giipi, dupanya nyakama mana langitae. Dopana, dupanya lao dee pepa pyao peakala naeyapenge.
Ambe lao palipataminopa, pake nenge mende kuakama epengeli pyoo, Kamongonya gii doko ipatana lao, nyakamame masokondape pyoo kalyamino.

Endakali dupame lao pituu, “Epe yuu yongamupa, naima mona yaepao kalyamanona” latami gii dokopa, enda wane maita pingili pyoo, koeyasingi doko dupa-kisa lee mendai ipatamopa, koeyasingi doko endakali dupame wandyepala paka pupenge nanjeta.
Dopaka doko, kaimii paluma, nyakama iminjetae dokonya nakalyamino dokonya, pake nenge mende epengeli pyoo gii doko nyakama-kisa naipata.
Tii pipae dokopa, kotaka gii dokopa, dolaponya nyakama ikiningi kalyamino. Kuka gii dokopa, iminjetae dokopa, dolaponya naima ikiningi nakalyamano.
Dopana, endakali waka dupa luu palengemali pyoo palya naenya, lenge tao masepae epe paliu katamana.
Luu palenge endakali dupa kuakama palengema. Bia longo lao napala kyakengema endakali dupa kuakama napala kyakengema.

Dopaka doko, naima kotaka kalyamano dupa masepae epe paliu katamana. Masepae epe paliu katao, yanda pyaanya sangalinya konambi pingili pyoo, Jisasa tungi pingi dokopa, endakali auu kaenge dokopa, dolapo naimame petae katamana. Goteme naima pyoo nyetana lao nee kaeyao malisingi doko aiyombanya aene balu joo petae katamana.
Goteme baanya imbu kaenge dokonya kalyepale latala naima makande nalea. Kamongo Jisasa Kraisame pyoo nyingi dokonya kalyepale latala naima makande lea.
Naima saka katatamanopapi, kumatamanopapi, Kraisa baa ipata gii dokopa, naima baa-pipa apata katatamanopa lao, Kraisa baa naimanya lao kumekea.
Tenge dokonya, nyakama-lapo mende mona yaka lasa-lasa pyoo, mende kyeto mai-mai pyoo kalyaminoli pyoaka kalyepape.
Pii Etao Leamo Doko

Kaimii paluma, nyakama mana tolatae dokonya kalyepale lao, akali mendapu aiyomba joo katao, nyakamanya kainanya kalai pyoo, mana langyoo, Kamongome katena lea. Katena leamo akali dupa nyakamame anda-anda semaiyoo kalyepale lao, naimame nyakama langilyamano.
Kalai dopale pilyamino dupa masetala, akali dupa nyakamame auu kaeyao eteteaka anda-anda semaiyoo kalyepape. Dopa petala, nyakama pitaka mona setao kalyepape.

Kaimii paluma, naimame nyakama kyeto joo dapa langilyamano: Kalai pyaanya maka-maka kaengema endakali dupa maka nakaena lao lamaiyepape. Walu lao paka kaengema endakali dupa kyeto maiyepape. Kyeto nasingi endakali dupa nisalapape. Nyakamame endakali dupa pitaka yapa maka nakaeyalapape.
Endakali mendeme endakali mende-kisa koo pitamopa, itingi yanu pyao koo napina lao lamaiyepape. Koteaka lao nyakama-lapopi, endakali wakapi, dupa pitaka-kisa nyakamame mana epe minao kalyepape.
Koteaka lao eteke pyao kalyepape.
Yakinala naeyao nyakamame loma soo kalyepape.
Dopale mendeme nyakama andinyala ipatamopa, Gote yaka pilyino lao kalyepape. Nyakama Jisasa Kraisa-kisa katao, dopa pyoo katami laka lao Goteme masilyamo.
Nyakamame Spiritanya itate doko konjala naeyalapape.
Propesi pii dupa sambo-lamo latala maka nakaeyalapape.
Dupa pitaka yapatala, epe dupa minakondape pyoo minalapape.
Mana koo tata dupa pitaka wandyoo kalyepape.

Mona yaepasingi Gote dokomeaka nyakama etao baanya latae jisetala, Kamongo Jisasa Kraisa ipata gii dokopa, nyakama auu pyoo katataminopa lao, nyakamanya imambupi, monapi, yongepi dupa pitakanya koo tengepi mende nasipya laka lao masilyamano.
Nyakama wii lao nyiamo Gote dokome mende pitona lelyamo doko kiningi pingi dokome angi pita.
Kaimii paluma, nyakamame naimanya loma sakalapape.
Endakali Gotenya latae dupame pipengeli pyoo, nyakamame Kristene kaiminingi dupa kopyoo nunu pyoo auu kaeyao lanyalapape.
Kamongonya kenge dokonya nyakamame Kristene kaiminingi Gotenya latae dupa pitakame sina, pepa pyao peekelyo dake itaki pyao lamaiyepale lao kyeto joo lelyo.
Naimanya Kamongo Jisasa Kraisanya kondo kaenge doko nyakama-kisa sipya laka lao masilyamano.
